newsitem.title: USA: Aquarion water utilities cleared for merger.
newsitem.headline: Aquarion water utilities cleared for merger.

text.p: The Connecticut Department of Public Utility Control on Wednesday approved a merger of Aquarion Co's Bridgeport Hydraulic Co with its Stamford Water Co, New Canaan Water Co and Ridgefield Water Supply Co units, Bridgeport Hydraulic said.

The merger, effective January 1, will result in all of Aquarian's Connecticut public water-supply companies being grouped into one entity -- to be called BHC Co -- for operational and adminstrative efficiency, it said.
While the new company would retain all employees, it expects to achieve future economies of scale through attrition.
